answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 47558 Country: India Title: Darood in namaaz Question: Which durood is to be read in salah after attahiyat? A friend of mine said that any durood can be read in salah. Answer ID: 47558 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1375/1048/H=10/1434) It is good to read durood Ibrahimi which is recited in salah. It is also enough to read any durood which is proved. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
